reason: After thorough review of the fiscal 2025 10-K filing, Fair Isaac Corporation does not disclose any TAM (Total Addressable Market) figures. The filing describes the company's products and services across two segments (Scores and Software), discusses geographic and product revenue breakdowns, and mentions operating in more than 80 countries, but does not provide any company-disclosed TAM estimates, market size figures, or addressable market data in any form.
